title: Brand Recall and Category Accuracy in Language Models: An Audit of 1,000 B2B SaaS Brands
abstract: arXiv:2611.33322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A language model can name a brand without classifying it correctly. This study measures these outcomes separately for 1,000 B2B SaaS brands across 333 product categories. On Gemma 4 12B, with no external retrieval, category prompts elicit 510 brands (51.0%). A separate five-candidate category probe ranks the reference label first for 787 brands, a distractor first for 194, and yields little separation for 19. Among the 981 separated rankings, the error rate is 19.8%. It falls to 3.5% for the 547 brands with a winner-to-runner-up log-probability margin above 0.6. These are within-cohort measurements, not calibrated confidence estimates. Exploratory regressions associate technical coverage with recall and an owned-properties composite with category accuracy, but the composites use different adjustment sets and do not establish causal effects. translated_title: 语言模型中的品牌召回与类别准确性：对1,000个B2B SaaS品牌的审计
translated_abstract: 语言模型能够说出一个品牌的名字，却不一定能正确地对其进行分类。本研究对333个产品类别中的1,000个B2B SaaS品牌分别测量了这两种结果。在Gemma 4 12B模型上，在没有外部检索的情况下，类别提示能够唤起510个品牌（51.0%）。在另一项独立的五候选类别探测中，787个品牌的参考标签排名第一，194个品牌的干扰项排名第一，另有19个品牌几乎无法区分。在981个具有区分度的排名中，错误率为19.8%；而对于获胜者与第二名之间对数概率差距超过0.6的547个品牌，错误率降至3.5%。这些是同一群体内的测量结果，而非经过校准的置信度估计。探索性回归分析显示，技术覆盖度与品牌召回相关，自有属性综合指标与类别准确性相关，但这些综合指标使用了不同的调整变量集，并未确立因果关系。在Gemma的四个世代中，测得的召回率分别为39.8%、44.3%、51.1%和51.0%。
tldr: 本研究对1,000个B2B SaaS品牌进行审计，发现语言模型的品牌召回能力与类别分类准确性并不一致，且当模型对首选类别与次选类别的对数概率差距较大时，分类错误率可大幅降低。
en_tdlr: This study audits 1,000 B2B SaaS brands across 333 categories, showing that language models can recall brands without classifying them correctly, with error rates dropping sharply when the winner-to-runner-up log-probability margin is large.
